message:
Dear {{ doc.first_name }}{% if doc.spouse %} and {{ frappe.db.get_value('Person', doc.spouse, 'first_name') }}{% endif %},

On behalf of your church family, we want to wish you a very happy anniversary! We thank the Lord for His grace and faithfulness in your marriage and pray His continued blessing on your home.

"What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder." — Mark 10:9

With love,
{{ frappe.db.get_value("Church", {"parent_church": ["is", "not set"]}, "church_name") or "Your Church Family" }}
name: Anniversary Greeting
subject: Happy Anniversary!
